ruleDefinitions.name: Registry Persistence via Explorer Run Key
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a possible persistence mechanism using RUN key for Windows Explorer and pointing to a suspicious folder Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX("\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Policies\\\\Explorer\\\\Run$") AND (Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\\\$Recycle\\\.bin\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Default\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR Details = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*")))
